```{r helper_functions}
# Helper function to log messages
# Helper function to log messages
log_message <- function(message, type = "INFO") {
  timestamp <- format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  log_entry <- paste0("[", timestamp, "] [", type, "] ", message)
  write(log_entry, log_file, append = TRUE)
  # Removed the message() call - only write to file
}

# Helper function to check file existence
check_files <- function(pdb_id) {
  uniplot_file <- file.path(UNIPLOT_DIR, paste0('uniplot.dat_', pdb_id))
  resdata_file <- file.path(RESDATA_DIR, paste0('resdata.dat_', pdb_id))
  
  uniplot_exists <- file.exists(uniplot_file)
  resdata_exists <- file.exists(resdata_file)
  
  if (!uniplot_exists) {
    log_message(paste("Missing uniplot file for PDB:", pdb_id), "WARNING")
  }
  if (!resdata_exists) {
    log_message(paste("Missing resdata file for PDB:", pdb_id), "WARNING")
  }
  
  return(uniplot_exists && resdata_exists)
}

# Helper function to parse uniplot data (simplified - no PFAM)
parse_uniplot_data <- function(pdb_id) {
  tryCatch({
    f <- file.path(UNIPLOT_DIR, paste0("uniplot.dat_", pdb_id))
    if (!file.exists(f)) {
      log_message(paste("Uniplot file missing for PDB:", pdb_id), "WARNING")
      return(NULL)
    }

    lines <- readLines(f, warn = FALSE)

    # minimal presence check (don't require [1] to have seq; require at least one seq somewhere)
    has_acc  <- any(grepl("^UNIPLOT_UNIPROT_ACC\\[",  lines))
    has_chain<- any(grepl("^UNIPLOT_CHAIN\\[",       lines))
    has_useq <- any(grepl("^UNIPLOT_UNIPROT_SEQ\\[", lines))
    has_pseq <- any(grepl("^UNIPLOT_PDB_SEQ\\[",     lines))

    if (!has_acc || !has_chain || !has_useq || !has_pseq) {
      log_message(paste("Incomplete uniplot data for PDB:", pdb_id), "WARNING")
      return(NULL)
    }

    list(pdb_id = pdb_id, lines = lines)

  }, error = function(e) {
    log_message(paste("Error parsing uniplot for PDB:", pdb_id, "-", e$message), "ERROR")
    return(NULL)
  })
}


# Helper function to create sequence table (no PFAM)
create_sequence_table <- function(uniplot_data) {
  if (is.null(uniplot_data) || is.null(uniplot_data$lines)) return(NULL)

  lines  <- uniplot_data$lines
  pdb_id <- tolower(uniplot_data$pdb_id)

  # Extract "KEY[index] value" into a named vector (names are indices like "1","2",...)
  get_idx_value <- function(lines, key) {
    m <- regexec(paste0("^", key, "\\[(\\d+)\\]\\s+(.*)$"), lines)
    hits <- regmatches(lines, m)
    hits <- hits[lengths(hits) > 0]
    if (length(hits) == 0) return(setNames(character(0), character(0)))
    vals <- vapply(hits, function(x) x[3], character(1))
    idx  <- vapply(hits, function(x) x[2], character(1))
    setNames(vals, idx)
  }

  chain   <- get_idx_value(lines, "UNIPLOT_CHAIN")
  acc     <- get_idx_value(lines, "UNIPLOT_UNIPROT_ACC")
  useq    <- get_idx_value(lines, "UNIPLOT_UNIPROT_SEQ")
  pdbseq  <- get_idx_value(lines, "UNIPLOT_PDB_SEQ")

  idx_all <- sort(unique(c(names(chain), names(acc), names(useq), names(pdbseq))))
  if (length(idx_all) == 0) return(NULL)

  seq_table <- data.frame(
    pdb_id         = rep(pdb_id, length(idx_all)),
    uniprot_seq    = unname(useq[idx_all]),
    uniprot_acc    = unname(acc[idx_all]),
    uniprot_chain  = unname(chain[idx_all]),
    uniprot_pdb_seq= unname(pdbseq[idx_all]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  # normalize empty strings to NA
  for (cn in c("uniprot_seq", "uniprot_pdb_seq", "uniprot_acc", "uniprot_chain")) {
    if (cn %in% colnames(seq_table)) {
      seq_table[[cn]][seq_table[[cn]] == ""] <- NA_character_
    }
  }

  seq_table
}



# Helper function to calculate alignment gaps
calculate_alignment_gaps <- function(seq_table) {
  alignment_emptness <- integer(0)

  for (i in seq_len(nrow(seq_table))) {
    pdb_seq <- seq_table$uniprot_pdb_seq[i]

    if (is.na(pdb_seq) || nchar(pdb_seq) == 0) {
      alignment_emptness <- c(alignment_emptness, NA_integer_)
      next
    }

    alignment_empty <- 0L
    for (cpos in seq_len(nchar(pdb_seq))) {
      if (substr(pdb_seq, cpos, cpos) == "-") alignment_empty <- alignment_empty + 1L else break
    }

    alignment_emptness <- c(alignment_emptness, alignment_empty)
  }

  seq_table$alignment_emptness <- alignment_emptness
  seq_table
}


```

```{r main_processing_with_renumbering}
log_message("Starting main processing with residue renumbering")

# Load PDB list
HET_pdb_only_drug_molecules_output_wo_na_only_human <- read.csv(PDB_LIST_FILE, sep = ',', header = TRUE)
pdb_ids <- unique(HET_pdb_only_drug_molecules_output_wo_na_only_human$PDB_ids)

log_message(paste("Total PDBs to process:", length(pdb_ids)))

# Initialize output dataframe (simplified - no PFAM columns)
pdb_id_ligand_residues_all <- data.frame(
  PDBid = character(),
  LigIdentifier = character(),
  HetIdentifier = character(),
  ResiduesContact = character(),
  ResidueChain = character(),
  uniprot_seq = character(),
  uniprot_acc = character(),
  pdb_id = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Process each PDB
processed_count <- 0
skipped_count <- 0
start_time <- Sys.time()

for (i in pdb_ids) { #pdb_ids
  
  # Progress update every 50 PDBs
  if ((processed_count + skipped_count) %% 50 == 0 && (processed_count + skipped_count) > 0) {
    elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), start_time, units = "mins"))
    total_processed <- processed_count + skipped_count
    rate <- total_processed / elapsed
    remaining <- length(pdb_ids) - total_processed
    eta_mins <- remaining / rate
    
    progress_msg <- sprintf("Progress: %d/%d PDBs (%.1f%%) | Processed: %d | Skipped: %d | ETA: %.0f min", 
                           total_processed, length(pdb_ids), 
                           100 * total_processed / length(pdb_ids),
                           processed_count, skipped_count, eta_mins)
    cat(progress_msg, "\n")
    log_message(progress_msg)
  }
  
  # Check if files exist
  if (!check_files(i)) {
    skipped_count <- skipped_count + 1
    next
  }
  
  log_message(paste("Processing PDB:", i))
  
  # Parse uniplot data
  uniplot_data <- parse_uniplot_data(i)
  if (is.null(uniplot_data)) {
    skipped_count <- skipped_count + 1
    next
  }
  
  # Create sequence table (no PFAM)
  seq_table <- create_sequence_table(uniplot_data)
  if (is.null(seq_table)) {
    skipped_count <- skipped_count + 1
    next
  }
  
  # Calculate alignment gaps
  seq_table_gap <- calculate_alignment_gaps(seq_table)
  
  # Read resdata file
  resdata <- read.csv(file.path(RESDATA_DIR, paste0('resdata.dat_', i)), 
                     header = FALSE, sep = '\t')
  
  # Check for duplicate chains (e.g., "CHAIN B = A" means B is same as A)
  chain_duplicates <- list()
  for (row_idx in 1:nrow(resdata)) {
    line <- resdata$V1[row_idx]
    if (grepl("^CHAIN [A-Z] = [A-Z]", line)) {
      parts <- strsplit(line, " ")[[1]]
      duplicate_chain <- parts[2]
      original_chain <- parts[4]
      chain_duplicates[[duplicate_chain]] <- original_chain
      cat(sprintf("Found duplicate: Chain %s = Chain %s\n", duplicate_chain, original_chain))
    }
  }
  
  # Renumber residues to align with UniProt sequence
  cat("\n=== STARTING RENUMBERING FOR PDB:", i, "===\n")
  cat("Number of chains to process:", nrow(seq_table_gap), "\n")
  
  for (each_row in seq_len(nrow(seq_table_gap))) {

    cat(sprintf("\n--- Processing chain %d/%d ---\n", each_row, nrow(seq_table_gap)))
  
    x <- 0
  
    each_emptness <- seq_table_gap$alignment_emptness[each_row]
    pdb_seq_full  <- seq_table_gap$uniprot_pdb_seq[each_row]
    chain_of_row  <- seq_table_gap$uniprot_chain[each_row]
  
    # Skip chains that have no sequence or no alignment emptiness
    if (is.na(each_emptness) || is.na(pdb_seq_full)) {
      cat("Skipping chain due to missing sequence/gaps. PDB:", i,
          "chain:", chain_of_row, "\n")
      next
    }
  
    new_residue_number <- each_emptness + 1
  
    pdb_alignment_new <- substr(pdb_seq_full, each_emptness + 1, nchar(pdb_seq_full))
    if (is.na(pdb_alignment_new) || nchar(pdb_alignment_new) == 0) {
      cat("Skipping chain because pdb_alignment_new is empty/NA. PDB:", i,
          "chain:", chain_of_row, "\n")
      next
    }

    cat(sprintf("Chain: %s, Leading gaps: %d, Starting position: %d\n",
                chain_of_row, each_emptness, new_residue_number))
  
    resdata_only_residues <- as.data.frame(resdata[nchar(resdata$V1) == 18, ])
    colnames(resdata_only_residues) <- c('Residues')
    only_chain_resdata_only_residue <- resdata_only_residues[
      grepl(paste0("  ", chain_of_row, " "), resdata_only_residues$Residues),
    ]
  
    for (j in seq_len(nchar(pdb_alignment_new))) {
      each_residue_id <- substr(pdb_alignment_new, j, j)
  
      if (each_residue_id != '-') {
        rownumber <- which(resdata$V1 == only_chain_resdata_only_residue[j - x])
  
        if (length(rownumber) > 0) {
          resdata$V1[rownumber] <- paste0(
            sprintf("%*s", 1, strsplit(only_chain_resdata_only_residue[j - x], split = "\\s+")[[1]][1]),
            sprintf("%*s", 4, strsplit(only_chain_resdata_only_residue[j - x], split = "\\s+")[[1]][2]),
            sprintf("%*s", 5, new_residue_number),
            sprintf("%*s", 3, strsplit(only_chain_resdata_only_residue[j - x], split = "\\s+")[[1]][4]),
            sprintf("%*s", 2, strsplit(only_chain_resdata_only_residue[j - x], split = "\\s+")[[1]][5]),
            sprintf("%*s", 3, strsplit(only_chain_resdata_only_residue[j - x], split = "\\s+")[[1]][6])
          )
        }
  
        new_residue_number <- new_residue_number + 1
      } else {
        x <- x + 1
      }
    }
  }

  # Extract ligand information
  lig_names <- c()
  lig_names_rows <- c()
  lig_ids <- c()
  lig_id_het_id <- data.frame(lig_ids = character(), het_names = character())
  
  for (eachrow in 1:length(resdata$V1)) {
    # Check if line starts with "LIGAND"
    if (grepl("^LIGAND", resdata$V1[eachrow])) {
      ligand_row <- resdata$V1[eachrow]
      lig_name <- strsplit(ligand_row, split = '\\s+')[[1]][3]
      lig_names <- append(lig_names, lig_name)
      lig_row <- resdata[grepl(lig_name, resdata$V1), ]
      lig_name_legend_name <- lig_row[grepl('LIGAND', lig_row)]
      
      if (!is_empty(lig_name_legend_name)) {
        lig_names_rows <- append(lig_names_rows, lig_name_legend_name)
        lig_ids <- append(lig_ids, paste0('LIG ', strsplit(lig_name_legend_name, ' ')[[1]][2]))
        lig_id_het_id <- data.frame(lig_ids = lig_ids, het_names = lig_names)
      }
    }
  }
  
  if (is_empty(lig_names_rows)) {
    log_message(paste("No ligands found for PDB:", i), "WARNING")
    skipped_count <- skipped_count + 1
    next
  }
  
  # Process residue contacts
  res_contacting_all_ids <- data.frame(X1 = character(), X2 = character(), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  output_resdata <- matrix(ncol = 3, nrow = length(resdata$V1))
  
  for (eachlig in lig_names_rows) {
    lig_id <- paste0('LIG ', strsplit(eachlig, ' ')[[1]][2])
    het_id <- strsplit(eachlig, ' ')[[1]][3]
    last_row_number <- 0
    output_resdata <- matrix(ncol = 3, nrow = length(resdata$V1))
    char_number <- 0
    char_lig_number <- 0
    
    for (eachrow in 1:length(resdata$V1)) {
      calc_nchar_row <- nchar(resdata$V1[eachrow])
      if (calc_nchar_row == 18) {
        char_lig_number <- 0
        char_number <- 1
        last_row_number <- eachrow
        output_resdata[eachrow, 1] <- resdata$V1[eachrow]
      } else if (calc_nchar_row > 18) {
        output_resdata[eachrow, 1] <- resdata$V1[eachrow]
        char_number <- 2
        char_lig_number <- 0
      }
      
      if (calc_nchar_row == 6) {
        char_lig_number <- char_lig_number + 1
        if (char_number == 1 && char_lig_number >= 2) {
          output_resdata[last_row_number, 2] <- resdata$V1[eachrow]
        } else {
          output_resdata[last_row_number, 3] <- resdata$V1[eachrow]
        }
      }
    }
    
    output_resdataX <- tidyr::unite(as.data.frame(output_resdata), col = 'X2', c('V2', 'V3'), sep = ',')
    output_resdata_df <- data.frame(output_resdataX)
    res_contacting <- output_resdata_df[grepl(lig_id, output_resdata_df$X2), ]
    res_contacting_all_ids <- rbind(res_contacting_all_ids, res_contacting)
    res_contacting_all_ids$X2 <- gsub("^ ", "", res_contacting_all_ids$X2)
    res_contacting_all_ids$X2 <- gsub('NA, ', '', res_contacting_all_ids$X2)
    res_contacting_all_idsX <- separate_rows(res_contacting_all_ids, X2, sep = ",")
    res_contacting_all_idsX$X2 <- gsub('^ ', '', res_contacting_all_idsX$X2)
    res_contacting_all_ids_drug_names <- merge(res_contacting_all_idsX, lig_id_het_id, 
                                               by.x = 'X2', by.y = 'lig_ids')
  }
  
  # Extract residue and chain information
  residues_contacting <- c()
  chain_contacting <- c()
  ligand_contacting <- c()
  hetid_contacting <- c()
  
  for (eachrow in 1:nrow(res_contacting_all_ids_drug_names)) {
    variable <- res_contacting_all_ids_drug_names$V1[eachrow]
    if (!is_empty(variable) && !is.na(variable)) {
      res_number <- strsplit(variable, "\\s+")[[1]][3]
      chain_number <- strsplit(variable, "\\s+")[[1]][4]
      lig_contacting <- res_contacting_all_ids_drug_names$X2[eachrow]
      het_contacting <- res_contacting_all_ids_drug_names$het_names[eachrow]
      residues_contacting <- append(residues_contacting, res_number)
      chain_contacting <- append(chain_contacting, chain_number)
      ligand_contacting <- append(ligand_contacting, lig_contacting)
      hetid_contacting <- append(hetid_contacting, het_contacting)
    }
  }
  
  if (is_empty(residues_contacting) || all(is.na(residues_contacting))) {
    log_message(paste("No valid residue contacts for PDB:", i), "WARNING")
    skipped_count <- skipped_count + 1
    next
  }
  
  # Create dataframe with all contact information
  pdb_ligand_residues <- cbind(
    as.data.frame(resdata[1, 1]),
    ligand_contacting,
    hetid_contacting,
    residues_contacting,
    chain_contacting
  )
  colnames(pdb_ligand_residues) <- c('PDBid', 'LigIdentifier', 'HetIdentifier', 
                                     'ResiduesContact', 'ResidueChain')
  
  # Add sequence information from seq_table
  for (eachrow in 1:nrow(pdb_ligand_residues)) {
    residue_chain <- pdb_ligand_residues$ResidueChain[eachrow]
    
    # Get sequence info for this chain
    chain_info <- seq_table[seq_table$uniprot_chain == residue_chain, ]
    
    if (nrow(chain_info) > 0) {
      pdb_ligand_residues$uniprot_seq[eachrow] <- chain_info$uniprot_seq[1]
      pdb_ligand_residues$uniprot_acc[eachrow] <- chain_info$uniprot_acc[1]
      pdb_ligand_residues$pdb_id[eachrow] <- toupper(chain_info$pdb_id[1])
    } else {
      pdb_ligand_residues$uniprot_seq[eachrow] <- NA
      pdb_ligand_residues$uniprot_acc[eachrow] <- NA
      pdb_ligand_residues$pdb_id[eachrow] <- NA
    }
  }
  
  pdb_id_ligand_residues_all <- rbind(pdb_id_ligand_residues_all, pdb_ligand_residues)
  processed_count <- processed_count + 1
}

log_message(paste("Processing complete. Processed:", processed_count, "Skipped:", skipped_count))
```

```{r merge_drug_data}

# Merge only on PDB ID and sequence (no PFAM!)
drug_pdb_ensp_seq <- merge(pdb_id_ligand_residues_all, 
                           ensg_enst_ensp_pdb_seqs, 
                           by.x = c('pdb_id', 'uniprot_seq'),

# Check how many rows have missing gene information

}
```

```{r compare_isoforms}
log_message("Starting isoform comparison with alignment-based approach")

# Initialize isoform-drug database
isoform_drug_database <- data.frame(
  pdb = character(),
  gene = character(),
  isoform = character(),
  drug = character(),
  drug_name = character(),
  interaction = character(),
  reference_enst = character(),
  interacting_residues = character(),  # NEW COLUMN
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

ENSG_list <- unique(drug_pdb_ensp_seq_only_drugs$Gene.stable.ID)
ENSG_list <- ENSG_list[!is.na(ENSG_list)]

log_message(paste("Processing", length(ENSG_list), "genes for isoform comparison"))

gene_count <- 0
isoform_start_time <- Sys.time()

for (each_ensg in ENSG_list) {
  gene_count <- gene_count + 1
  
  # Progress update every 25 genes
  if (gene_count %% 25 == 0) {
    elapsed <- as.numeric(difftime(Sys.time(), isoform_start_time, units = "mins"))
    rate <- gene_count / elapsed
    remaining <- length(ENSG_list) - gene_count
    eta_mins <- remaining / rate
    
    progress_msg <- sprintf("Isoform comparison: %d/%d genes (%.1f%%) | ETA: %.0f min", 
                           gene_count, length(ENSG_list),
                           100 * gene_count / length(ENSG_list), eta_mins)
    cat(progress_msg, "\n")
    log_message(progress_msg)
  }
  
  pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg <- drug_pdb_ensp_seq_only_drugs[
    drug_pdb_ensp_seq_only_drugs$Gene.stable.ID == each_ensg, 
  ] %>% distinct()
  
  each_ensg_enst_ensp_pdb_seqs <- ensg_enst_ensp_pdb_seqs[
    ensg_enst_ensp_pdb_seqs$Gene.stable.ID == each_ensg, 
  ] %>% distinct()
  
  pdb_list <- unique(pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg$pdb_id)
  
  for (each_pdb in pdb_list) {
    ligands_list <- unique(pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg[
      pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg$pdb_id == each_pdb, 'LigIdentifier'
    ])
    
    for (each_ligand in ligands_list) {
      transcript_id <- unique(pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg[
        pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg$LigIdentifier == each_ligand & 
        pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg$pdb_id == each_pdb, 'Transcript.stable.ID'
      ])
      
      drug_name <- unique(pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg[
        pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg$LigIdentifier == each_ligand & 
        pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg$pdb_id == each_pdb, 'HetIdentifier'
      ])
      
      # Get binding residues (UniProt numbering)
      residues_contacting <- pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg[
        pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg$pdb_id == each_pdb & 
        pdb_id_ligand_residues_ensg$LigIdentifier == each_ligand, 
      ] %>% pull(ResiduesContact) %>% gsub('[A-z]', '', .) %>% unique()
      
      other_isoforms_list <- unique(each_ensg_enst_ensp_pdb_seqs$Transcript.stable.ID)
      
      biomart_sequence_of_isoform <- unique(each_ensg_enst_ensp_pdb_seqs[
        each_ensg_enst_ensp_pdb_seqs$Transcript.stable.ID %in% transcript_id, 'Seq'
      ])
      
      if (length(biomart_sequence_of_isoform) == 0) {
        log_message(paste("No sequence found for reference transcript", transcript_id), "WARNING")
        next
      }
      
      for (each_isoform in other_isoforms_list) {
        isoform_sequence <- unique(each_ensg_enst_ensp_pdb_seqs[
          each_ensg_enst_ensp_pdb_seqs$Transcript.stable.ID == each_isoform, 'Seq'
        ])
        
        if (length(isoform_sequence) == 0) {
          next
        }
        
        # Perform pairwise alignment
        Alignment_Transcripts <- tryCatch({
          pwalign::pairwiseAlignment(isoform_sequence, biomart_sequence_of_isoform, type = 'local-global')
        }, error = function(e) {
          log_message(paste("Alignment error for", each_isoform, ":", e$message), "WARNING")
          return(NULL)
        })
        
        if (is.null(Alignment_Transcripts)) {
          next
        }
        
        Alignment_Transcripts_ref <- as.vector(alignedSubject(Alignment_Transcripts))
        Alignment_Transcripts_as <- as.vector(alignedPattern(Alignment_Transcripts))
        
        Aligned_ref_trans_charc <- strsplit(Alignment_Transcripts_ref, '')[[1]]
        Aligned_as_trans_charc <- strsplit(Alignment_Transcripts_as, '')[[1]]
        
        # Create new residue numbering
        new_residue_numbering <- c()
        first_residue <- 0
        for (each_residue in Aligned_ref_trans_charc) {
          if (each_residue == '-') {
            first_residue <- first_residue + 1
          } else {
            first_residue <- first_residue + 1
            new_residue_numbering <- append(new_residue_numbering, first_residue)
          }
        }
        
        # Add extended residues (±2, ±1 from binding residues)
        residues_contacting_extended <- as.numeric(residues_contacting)
        for (offset in RESIDUE_EXTENSION) {
          residues_contacting_extended <- append(residues_contacting_extended, 
                                                as.numeric(residues_contacting) + offset)
        }
        residues_contacting_extended <- unique(residues_contacting_extended[residues_contacting_extended > 0])
        
        # Get residues at these positions
        valid_positions <- residues_contacting_extended[residues_contacting_extended <= length(new_residue_numbering)]
        new_interacting_residues <- Aligned_ref_trans_charc[new_residue_numbering[valid_positions]]
        residues_on_isoform <- Aligned_as_trans_charc[new_residue_numbering[valid_positions]]
        
        # Check if binding sites match
        binding_match <- setequal(new_interacting_residues, residues_on_isoform)
        
        # Calculate which residues in the ISOFORM are binding (if any)
        isoform_binding_residues <- NA
        if (binding_match) {
          # For YES: find the actual residue positions in the isoform sequence
          # Map the reference positions to isoform positions
          isoform_residue_positions <- c()
          
          # Get only the core binding residues (not extended ±2, ±1)
          core_residues <- as.numeric(residues_contacting)
          
          # Check for NA values and log warning if found
          if (any(is.na(core_residues))) {
            na_count <- sum(is.na(core_residues))
            log_message(paste("WARNING: Found", na_count, "NA values in core_residues for",
                              each_pdb, each_ligand, "- skipping invalid positions"), "WARNING")
           # cat(sprintf("  Original residues_contacting: %s\n", paste(residues_contacting, collapse=",")))
           # cat(sprintf("  After as.numeric: %s\n", paste(core_residues, collapse=",")))
          }
          
          # Remove NA values to avoid "missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed" error
          core_residues <- core_residues[!is.na(core_residues)]
          
          # If no valid residues remain after removing NAs, skip this iteration
          if (length(core_residues) == 0) {
            log_message(paste("No valid core residues for", each_pdb, each_ligand, "- skipping"), "WARNING")
            next
          }
          
          for (core_res in core_residues) {
            if (core_res <= length(new_residue_numbering)) {
              # Find position in alignment
              align_pos <- new_residue_numbering[core_res]
              
              # Count non-gap positions up to this point in isoform sequence
              isoform_pos <- sum(Aligned_as_trans_charc[1:align_pos] != "-")
              
              # Only include if this position is not a gap in the isoform
              if (Aligned_as_trans_charc[align_pos] != "-") {
                isoform_residue_positions <- append(isoform_residue_positions, isoform_pos)
              }
            }
          }
          
          if (length(isoform_residue_positions) > 0) {
            # Sort the residue positions for easier reading
            isoform_residue_positions <- sort(unique(isoform_residue_positions))
            isoform_binding_residues <- paste(isoform_residue_positions, collapse = ",")
          }
        }
        
        # Check if binding sites match
        isoform_drug_db <- data.frame(
          pdb = each_pdb,
          gene = each_ensg,
          isoform = each_isoform,
          drug = each_ligand,
          drug_name = paste(drug_name, collapse = ","),
          interaction = ifelse(binding_match, "YES", "NO"),
          reference_enst = paste(transcript_id, collapse = ","),
          interacting_residues = isoform_binding_residues,  # Now isoform-specific
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        
        isoform_drug_database <- rbind(isoform_drug_database, isoform_drug_db)
      }
    }
  }
}

log_message(paste("Isoform comparison complete. Total rows:", nrow(isoform_drug_database)))
```

```{r save_results}
        file = file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, 'isoform_drug_database_last.RDS'))

# Save as TSV

           file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, 'isoform_drug_database.tsv'),
```
